headline: Georgian Court outscore every rival and still leak goals
dek: Georgian Court's win at Chestnut Hill was their fifth of the season, beside two draws and two defeats. Their 22 goals are more than any other programme in the conference has scored; they have also conceded seventeen, so the scoring is carrying a defence that gives goals back.

pattern.label: observed
pattern.text: Dominican have scored five goals and conceded eighteen; the foot of the chart belongs to a side with one win, two draws and six defeats, whose trouble is at both ends of the pitch rather than one.

wire.line: Wilmington have drawn more matches than they have won or lost, and no other side in the conference has drawn as many.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Post's win at Monroe was their fifth of the season, beside two draws and two defeats; they have scored fifteen goals and conceded nine.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Jefferson have still not drawn a match this season: the win over Goldey-Beacom is their second, beside six defeats, with fourteen goals scored and nineteen conceded.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Gijs van Eif has scored seven goals for Georgian Court and assisted six more, from 40 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Eliass Elfasoukhi has scored six of Post's goals from eighteen shots, with one assist beside them.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Bruno Mestres has made 61 saves for Holy Family and conceded sixteen, a save percentage of .792.

last_match.line: Georgian Court have yet to drop a point in conference play; Chestnut Hill have yet to take one.

next_match.line: Felician are unbeaten in conference play after a draw at Wilmington and a win over Caldwell; Georgian Court have won both of theirs.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
